strings.app.title: RETURN TO MADNESS
strings.app.tagline2: HE WHO WATCHES IS ALSO WATCHED.
strings.app.reset_hint: OR PRESS DELETE TO START OVER
strings.ui.hint: A/D MOVE · SPACE JUMP · J STRIKE · K DODGE · L THE VOICE
strings.death.title: THE TIDE RETURNS YOU
strings.end.title: THE SEVENTH SEAL
strings.end.body:
Cthulhu opens one eye.

There is no battle. Only the weight of being seen.

The Witness kneels and the lantern goes out.
Madness reaches 7 / 7.

The world folds into itself and begins again.
Innsmouth. Again. The same rain.

The Witness descends once more, madness intact,
with the vague feeling of having written this before.
strings.stage.costa.name: THE DROWNED COAST
strings.stage.costa.subtitle: INNSMOUTH · LOW TIDE
strings.stage.costa.intro:
The Order kept seven seals.
Someone is opening them from within.
strings.stage.costa.revelation:
The first seal was not on the coast.
It was in your chest, and it was gone.
strings.stage.costa.frag.0:
The fish of Innsmouth wore faces.
I did not want to look, and still I looked.
strings.stage.costa.frag.1:
The keeper wrote: «the water rises though it does not rain».
His lamp still burns.
strings.stage.costa.frag.2:
In the customs ledger, the same ship
sailed seven times on the same day.
strings.stage.criptas.name: THE CRYPTS OF DAGON
strings.stage.criptas.subtitle: BENEATH INNSMOUTH · LEVEL -2
strings.stage.criptas.intro: Beneath the harbour, the stone remembers another tide.
strings.stage.criptas.revelation:
The stair goes down in a spiral.
You have descended it before. The steps know.
strings.stage.criptas.frag.0:
Dagon is not a god. He is a stage of the road.
Those who reach the top learn it too late.
strings.stage.criptas.frag.1:
The priests tied weights to themselves so they would not float.
One of them needed no weight.
strings.stage.criptas.frag.2:
Here they baptised twice: once with water,
and once with something that breathes inside the water.
strings.stage.biblioteca.name: THE FORBIDDEN WING
strings.stage.biblioteca.subtitle: MISKATONIC · ARKHAM
strings.stage.biblioteca.intro: Some books are not read. They are heard.
strings.stage.biblioteca.revelation:
You understood a word that does not exist.
From that moment, the world has a crack.
strings.stage.biblioteca.frag.0:
The Necronomicon was not reading me.
It was translating me.
strings.stage.biblioteca.frag.1:
Someone wrote in the margin: «this is not a text,
it is a door with an index».
strings.stage.biblioteca.frag.2:
The librarian has spent 40 years sorting
the same shelf. The shelf is gone.
strings.stage.meseta.name: THE PLATEAU OF LENG
strings.stage.meseta.subtitle: KADATH · FULL MOON
strings.stage.meseta.intro: The cold does not come from the ice. It comes from above.
strings.stage.meseta.revelation:
The sky is not a ceiling.
It is an eyelid, half closed.
strings.stage.meseta.frag.0:
There was no summit. Only an open eye
and the certainty of being read.
strings.stage.meseta.frag.1:
The hunters of Leng do not kill from hunger.
They hunt so that something will watch them.
strings.stage.meseta.frag.2:
The moon has a mouth. You cannot see it
from below. You see it from inside.
strings.stage.yuggoth.name: THE ABYSS OF YUGGOTH
strings.stage.yuggoth.subtitle: MACHINE-CITY · OUTER ORBIT
strings.stage.yuggoth.intro:
Here brains are kept in jars.
And still they feel fear.
strings.stage.yuggoth.revelation:
You are not descending.
You are climbing inside a body.
strings.stage.yuggoth.frag.0:
My brain was in a jar and still
it felt fear. That was the most human thing I remember.
strings.stage.yuggoth.frag.1:
The Mi-Go have no gods. They have
suppliers, and we are the order.
strings.stage.yuggoth.frag.2:
The machine sings in seven times.
One of those times is your name.
strings.stage.rlyeh.name: THE DREAM OF R'LYEH
strings.stage.rlyeh.subtitle: NON-EUCLIDEAN CITY · NO SURFACE
strings.stage.rlyeh.intro:
There is no above. There is no below.
Only angles that should not meet.
strings.stage.rlyeh.revelation:
The sixth seal was a person.
You knew them from behind, as always.
strings.stage.rlyeh.frag.0:
I saw myself in a mirror of water.
I recognised myself. He did not.
strings.stage.rlyeh.frag.1:
Here the walls are the same corridor
seen from seven places at once.
strings.stage.rlyeh.frag.2:
I found my own handwriting on a wall.
It said: «do not cross the seventh».
strings.stage.trono.name: THE THRONE OF THE SLEEPER
strings.stage.trono.subtitle: R'LYEH · THE DREAMING CHAMBER
strings.stage.trono.intro:
The one who dreams is not asleep.
He dreams of whoever descends.
strings.stage.trono.revelation:
You broke it. In another turn.
And you have descended the same stair for centuries.
strings.stage.trono.frag.0:
The seven seals were not doors.
They were the fingers of a closed hand.
strings.stage.trono.frag.1:
The cult did not wake him.
They only brushed the hair from his eyes.
strings.stage.trono.frag.2:
I am the seventh seal.
I always was.
